title: Changes your connected apps proposed
description: A connected app such as Claude or ChatGPT never changes anything itself: each change it proposes waits here for you. Confirming runs it with your own access. A proposal expires after 7 days.

refusals.ai_suggestion_not_proposed: This change was already confirmed, rejected or expired.
refusals.ai_suggestion_expired: This proposal has expired. Ask the app again.
refusals.agent_grant_revoked: You no longer let this app act for you, so its changes cannot be confirmed.
refusals.agent_outside_grant: This change is outside what you let the app reach.
refusals.agent_operation_restricted: A connected app cannot propose a change that reaches Restricted data or the organization's control.
refusals.agent_operation_unknown: XOS no longer offers this kind of change. Reject it.
refusals.ai_suggestion_needs_person: A connected app cannot confirm its own change; confirm it here.
refusals.stale: The record changed after the app read it. Reject this proposal and ask the app again.
